evals.prompt: How do I securely store and retrieve database credentials in my PowerShell automation script?
evals.expected_output: Recommends SecretManagement + SecretStore. Shows Register-SecretVault, Set-Secret, Get-Secret workflow. Warns against hardcoding credentials. Provides rollback or alternative (Get-Credential for interactive). No plaintext secrets in examples.

evals.prompt: I need to set up JEA so my helpdesk team can restart specific services without full admin rights.
evals.expected_output: Shows full JEA setup: New-PSRoleCapabilityFile with ValidateSet for allowed services, New-PSSessionConfigurationFile with RoleDefinitions, Register-PSSessionConfiguration. Includes audit logging via -TranscriptDirectory. Explains NoLanguage mode.

evals.prompt: How do I enable Script Block Logging and WDAC for PowerShell on our production servers?
evals.expected_output: Shows registry path for ScriptBlockLogging (HKLM:\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\PowerShell\ScriptBlockLogging). Shows WDAC policy creation with New-CIPolicy and Set-RuleOption. Includes code signing with Set-AuthenticodeSignature. Mentions Constrained Language Mode.
